{{Quote|Imperial Knight ''Rand Ko'' to Bastion battle command! Our lines are broken and the battle is lost! What is your will, my Emperor? Retreat or fight to the death?|Rand Ko|<ref name="Legacy War 2" />}}
'''Rand Ko''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]] as an [[Imperial Knight]] Master. In [[138 ABY]], he led a group of Fel's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in [[Battle of Borosk (138 ABY)|defense]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Borosk/Legends|Borosk]], which was under siege by forces of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. When [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] overwhelmed his battle lines, Ko contacted his Emperor and asked for instructions. He was ordered to retreat but was attacked by a [[Unidentified Sith (Borosk)|Sith]] before he could relay the order to his [[Trooper/Legends|troops]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Retreat, Master Ko! I command you to take your troops to safety&hellip;''"<br />"''CONNECTION LOST.|Emperor Roan Fel and a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]]|<ref name="Legacy War 2" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Rand Ko served as an [[Imperial Knight]] in [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]] and had been granted the title of Master by [[138 ABY]]. The Empire-in-exile was at [[Sith–Imperial War|war]] with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]], and in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Krayt began a renewed military push against his enemies. When [[One Sith|Sith]]&ndash;Imperial forces [[Battle of Borosk (138 ABY)|attacked]] the Fel-held [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Borosk/Legends|Borosk]], Ko commanded [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] loyal to Fel in defense of the planet.<ref name="Legacy War 2" />

Ko and his forces were overwhelmed by the enemy [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], who broke through their battle lines and prompted the Knight to contact his Emperor and ask for instructions. He placed a [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] call to Fel's [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] and reported to the Emperor that the battle was lost. When he asked if his forces should fight to the [[Death/Legends|death]], Fel shouted at Ko to retreat and to take his [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] to safety. Ko was approached by one of Krayt's [[Unidentified Sith (Borosk)|Sith]] while the order was being issued, and he raised his [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|lightsaber]] in defense as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] attacked. At that point, his [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] connection with Fel cut out.<ref name="Legacy War 2" />

==Powers and abilities==
Rand Ko was a member of the Imperial Knights,<ref name="Legacy War 2" /> an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] dedicated to protecting Emperor Fel and preserving his Empire. The Imperial Knights were considered to be among the most talented and dangerous [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Ko held the rank of Master,<ref name="Legacy War 2" /> which was a title reserved for the organization's highest-ranking members.<ref name="LECG" /> In 138 ABY, Ko was in charge of the Empire's ground forces on Borosk but was unable to lead them to victory against an overwhelming attack by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt's Imperials.<ref name="Legacy War 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Sorry I could not hold Borosk for the True Empire 'it appears' I will die A Great and Glorious Death! Thank you!|Randy Ko|<ref name="Randy">{{WebCite|url=http://www.comicscommunity.com/boards/janduursema/?read=70326&expand=1#70326|text=Imperial Knight Rand Ko|author="Rand Ko"|date=2011-02-09|work=Jan Duursema Message Board|nobackup=1}}</ref>}}
[[File:Randyko.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Randy Ko at Celebration V]]
Rand Ko was created by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]] for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries [[Star Wars: Legacy — War|''Star Wars: Legacy—War'']] and appears in two panels of its [[Legacy — War 2|second issue]],<ref name="Legacy War 2" /> released on [[January 26]], [[2011]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54442/star_wars_legacy_-_war_2010_2|text=Star Wars: Legacy - War (2010) #2}}</ref> Duursema's inspiration for the character came from Randy Ko, a costumer and member of the [[501st Legion (fan organization)|501st Legion fan organization]] whom she met at the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Celebration V]] event in [[2010]].<ref name="Randy" /> Randy was wearing custom-made [[Imperial Knight armor]] and posed for Duursema;<ref name="Duursema2">{{DMCite|dm=File:Randisrandy.jpg|creator=[[Jan Duursema]]|date=2011-02-10}}</ref> he later stated that he was honored she remembered him and included him in the issue. When he thanked her for giving the character what appeared to be a glorious death in combat,<ref name="Randy" /> Duursema indicated that the question of Ko's death had intentionally been left up in the air.<ref name="Duursema">{{WebCite|url=http://www.comicscommunity.com/boards/janduursema/?read=70396&expand=1#70396|text=Imperial Knight Rand Ko|author=[[Jan Duursema]]|date=2011-02-09|work=Jan Duursema Message Board|nobackup=1}}</ref>
